new_value: Implemented: SlotMap::new validates via validate_dimensions (rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs:323-335) rejecting gateway_count==0 / slots==0 (InvalidDimensions), over-max slots (TooManySlots) and gateway count (TooManyGateways); InvalidOrdinal/InvalidSlot variants cover ordinal>=count and out-of-range slots (slot.rs:68-71). owned_slots' u16 arithmetic (slot.rs:346-349) runs only after these bounds, so no zero-count infinite loop or truncation; the resources.rs 'as u8' hit is an enum From impl, not CBOR truncation. 34 slot tests pass (cargo test -p lichen-gateway --lib slot).
